messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jillian Park <jillian.park@cornerstoneretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delegated signatory verification and evidence for resale exemption hold

Hi Jillian,

Thanks for the quick pickup on this. Finance has placed invoices INV-2026-2107 / INV-2026-2108 (total $28,412.00) on hold pending verification of your resale blanket. The copy we received shows a signatory ("M. Ruiz") that is not a named officer on the incorporation record and the printed name doesn't exactly match the EIN holder.

To clear the hold we need evidence that the person who signed the resale certificate is authorized to bind Cornerstone Retail. The quickest acceptable options are:
- A notarized delegation/POA that explicitly authorizes the signer to execute resale certificates on behalf of the EIN in question, OR
- A board resolution or corporate secretary letter naming the signer, plus a matching incorporation document showing the EIN and legal name.

Can you confirm which you can provide and, if available, attach a notarized POA or a signed corporate secretary letter? If you have a DocuSign envelope for the delegation that includes IP/identity verification, a link is also helpful.

If we can get the delegation/POA and a copy of the signed incorporation record by EOD tomorrow PDT we can release the invoice hold and queue payment in the next remittance run.

Appreciate the help — looping Grace and Lauren for intake/acceptance.

Best,
Karthik
Account Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Docs attached: delegation_POA_notarized.pdf, signed_incorporation_record.pdf
DocuSign envelope (for the POA): https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ123456

Please let me know if this is sufficient to clear the hold.

Karthik / Lauren —

Got the docs from Jillian via Marco. Quick intake notes from tax intake:
- Notarized POA (delegation_POA_notarized.pdf) includes the signatory name + explicit authority to execute tax/resale certificates for the named EIN. Good.
- Incorporation extract matches the legal name and EIN (signed_incorporation_record.pdf). Good.
- We need to record the notary jurisdiction and the POA effective date; Marcos scan includes the notary block (jurisdiction: CA, county listed). That meets our acceptance criteria for now.

Acceptance checklist passed, pending one internal step: Ben, please cross-check the signer name on the POA against our vendor master (EIN mapping) and confirm the vendor record COR-8891 is updated to include the POA metadata (scan date, notary state). Once Ben confirms, Finance can release the hold.

If there's any state-specific nuance (e.g., TX requiring form ST-2 equivalent), we will flag, but Cornerstone is CA-based and the CA notarized POA plus incorporation extract is usually sufficient.

Lauren, Ill drop the docs into the secure vendor folder under /shared/tax-evidence/COR-8891 and tag the intake ticket.

Thanks,
Grace
Billing & Tax Intake Lead
Redwood Inference

Jillian —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Marco. We completed internal acceptance this afternoon: the notarized POA and incorporation extract meet our document acceptance criteria and Ben updated the vendor master to include the POA reference. Finance has released invoice holds INV-2026-2107 and INV-2026-2108; payment is scheduled in the next ACH cycle (expected settlement 2026-07-02).

For our records I saved the PDFs to the secure vendor evidence folder and linked the DocuSign envelope under the deal record. You should receive confirmation of payment from accounting once the remittance posts.

If Cornerstone prefers a standing arrangement to avoid future holds, we can accept a signed blanket + POA on file and configure future invoices to auto-release. Happy to schedule a 15-minute call to confirm the intake form to keep on file.

Best regards,
Karthik
Account Manager, Revenue Operations
